name: Swarm Markets test xTokens left registered in XTokenWrapper with unguarded mint
summary: Two XToken contracts Swarm deployed in January 2024 had mint() and burnFrom() without the wrapper-role check, and XTokenWrapper still mapped them to USDC and DAI in xTokenToToken after the team re-pointed tokenToXToken to other xTokens. Anyone could mint them and unwrap() for the wrapper's real collateral: one attacker minted xUSDC and unwrapped 3,311 USDC, and a frontrunning bot minted xDAI and unwrapped 7,725 DAI three blocks later.
notes: The anchor's attacker 0x38f68f11 minted its xUSDC in setup transaction 0xacd17bb4; an earlier xDAI mint to 0xc5a2af4d (0x8a0e2be4) was never unwrapped. The 7,725 DAI unwrap by 0xc0ffeebabe paid 2.56 ETH of its proceeds to the block builder, so it is a campaign exploit, not a rescue.

Reset: XTokenWrapper first mapped xUSDC to USDC in 0xfabd6614; two later registrations rewrote the same value, and re-pointing tokenToXToken[USDC] to 0x80e32d09 left that mapping in place. Swarm unregistered both test xTokens in 0xebafb868 and refilled the wrapper from 0x9fffe8e9; the refill is not subtracted (rule 11).
